purpose: Teach: 車種/日本円/丸の内/新橋/読み物/スチール/ストリーム/ポータブル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社用車の車種を一台に統一された
lines.en: Your father standardized the company vehicles to a single model when he founded the business.
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried recollection. Warm gaze into middle distance. Speak as one who witnessed it. Slight pause before the key detail, as if letting the memory settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは海外取引の日本円換算に詳しかった
lines.en: Yes. He had a real gift for currency conversion on international deals.
lines.style: Acknowledging nod in the voice. Quiet conviction — not boasting, just stating what was true. Steady, measured pace. A son confirming his father's character.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、丸の内の銀行に勤められた
lines.en: When he was young, he worked at a bank in Marunouchi.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. As if seeing the younger version of his father. Gentle cadence, letting each detail breathe. Eyes narrowing slightly with affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新橋で接待をされた
lines.en: Yes. He entertained clients in Shinbashi.
lines.style: Reflective acknowledgment. Voice carries the weight of understanding what that meant — the care, the effort. Slight pause between statements, holding space for the memory's significance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員向け読み物を毎月編集された
lines.en: He edited the staff newsletter every month — always had his hand in everything.
lines.style: Gentle wonder in the delivery. Slight smile in the voice. Remembering the man who cared about the small things that held a company together. Warm, unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはスチール製品の品質に厳しかった
lines.en: Yes. But he was exacting about the quality of our steel products.
lines.style: Calm, steady affirmation. Voice carries respect — not fear. Understanding that exactness came from care. Slight emphasis on 「厳しかった」in the tone: he demanded because he knew what mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新しい配信ストリームに早く対応された
lines.en: He was quick to adapt to new distribution channels — ahead of the curve.
lines.style: Admiring recollection. Light lift on 「早く」— surprise at his father's forward-thinking. Warm, almost proud cadence. The voice of a son recognizing his father's foresight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはポータブル機器の導入に積極的だった
lines.en: Yes. He was eager to adopt portable equipment — always looked to the future.
lines.style: Closing reflection with weight and tenderness. Voice gentles slightly. A final affirmation of a life well-lived. Slow, deliberate pace. The finality of deep respect and love.
